absorption: Upstream exposes suitable configurable iteration budgets or the deployed models reliably complete within upstream defaults and the local overrides can be removed.

consumers.name: Dream deduction and induction paths using tool-capable DeepSeek models.

contract: Dream specialists have larger bounded tool-loop iteration budgets so DeepSeek-backed deduction/induction can complete valid multi-step work without premature loop exhaustion.

fork: inspect the three specialist iteration caps and exercise bounded dream deduction/induction with the deployment model while watching for tool-loop cap warnings.
proof.fork_expected: configured specialists expose 20/20/15 and representative DeepSeek dream work completes within those bounds.
upstream: inspect the same specialist caps on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: Base/Deduction/Induction caps are 15/12/10 rather than the fork's 20/20/15.

upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base uses lower Base/Deduction/Induction specialist iteration caps that are insufficient for the deployment's observed DeepSeek tool loops.
